title: Probabilistic quant acceptance guardian with contextual metrics
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Build an automated acceptance guardian for quantized model variants (FP8/INT8) that uses probabilistic, context-aware gates to decide pass/fail. The guardian should combine multiple signal types (semantic similarity via embeddings, token-level KL/logit metrics, and per-prompt failure detectors) and expose dynamic thresholds per prompt-category and traffic bucket.
background: Current quant acceptance checks are brittle: static thresholds across all prompts cause false positives on long-tail prompts and miss small but meaningful regressions on high-frequency cases. Our goal is a harness that (1) detects regressions introduced by FP8/INT8 profiles, (2) calibrates thresholds automatically using representative traces, and (3) integrates into CI and the console rollout flow with clear telemetry and automatic rollback for high-severity failures.
proposed_solution: Implement a probabilistic gating layer on top of the existing automated evaluation harness that: 1) builds per-prompt-category baseline distributions from golden prompt replay (multiple seeds), 2) computes composite scores combining embedding cosine similarity, token-level KL and next-token prediction accuracy, and 3) applies tiered gates (hard/soft) with percentile-based dynamic thresholds. Add a stochastic perturbation mode that simulates quant noise by repeated sampling and aggregates failure probabilities. Integrate calibration workflows (collect traces, per-layer scale estimation, bias correction for INT8) and surface suggested quant profile changes when failures are localizable to specific layers or tokens.
acceptance_criteria: CI job 'quant-guardian/eval' runs nightly and on PRs for quant profile changes
Composite metric (semantic_cosine*0.6 + normalized_inv_KL*0.3 + NTPA*0.1) must not drop more than 0.5% for the P0 prompt set compared to baseline
Per-prompt failure probability computed via 30 stochastic samples must be < 0.01 for >95% of P0 prompts
Dynamic thresholds are computed from baseline traces and stored with timestamped snapshots; evaluation uses the latest snapshot unless overridden
When hard gate fails for a production rollout, auto-block and trigger rollback workflow with annotated diff and PR link
Dashboard exposes per-model, per-profile, per-prompt-group histograms plus top-10 failing prompts updated in <15 minutes after run completion
implementation_notes: Add 'guardian' mode to existing quant eval harness: new flag --guardian and --stochastic-samples=N
Dataset: derive P0/P1/P2 prompt groups from traffic traces stored in telemetry (use 30-day window) and export golden replay bundles to GCS
Calibration step: run per-layer activation histograms, compute per-channel scale factors, and run bias-correction pass for INT8 zero-points
Scoring: reuse embedding pipeline (embedding-v1) for semantic similarity; implement token-KL with softmax temperature 1.0 and NTPA (next-token-prediction-accuracy) metric
CI: add Jenkins/GitHub Action matrix entries for FP8 and INT8 profiles and a nightly job that gates against baseline snapshots
PRs: open GH PRs against runtime and eval harness repo. Prototype PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2598
test_plan: Unit tests for scoring functions (embedding cosine, token-KL, NTPA) with synthetic logits
Integration test: run guardian mode against a known-good model (fp32) and a seeded int8 profile that introduces a small KL shift; assert composite metric captures the regression
Stochastic sensitivity test: confirm increasing stochastic samples reduces false-positive variance (plot in CI artifacts)
Adversarial check: feed adversarial prompts from 'long-tail-adversarial-v1' and verify failure probability increases for broken profiles
Layer-localization smoke: when harness flags a failure, run targeted per-layer sim to produce a ranked list of suspicious layers
telemetry: Composite metric time-series per model/profile in Console > Quant QC
Per-prompt-group distribution heatmaps (95/99 percentiles) refreshed after each nightly run
Top failing prompts table with failure probability and recent diffs
Alerting: Slack + PagerDuty for hard-gate failures on production rollouts; email for soft-gate regressions
Logs: store per-run artifacts (golden replay, sampled outputs, per-prompt metrics) in s3 for 30 days
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): run nightly guardian on dev models for two weeks and refine dynamic threshold percentiles
Phase 2 (canary): enable guardian for dedicated cluster rollouts with soft-gate enforcement and manual review for 48h
Phase 3 (production): enable hard gates for automated rollbacks on model profile updates that affect P0 prompts
Communication: postmortem template and automated incident playbook triggered by rollback
Fallbacks: fallback to next-best profile when rollback fails; notify owner via console
